Praline Croissant Women's/NB Ride

Cambridge, MA · Alewife · Road

Praline Croissant Women's/NB Ride is a road group ride in Cambridge, MA. It rolls every Friday at 6:30 am from Minuteman Bikeway Trailhead – Alewife.

For visitors

For women, women-identifying and nonbinary riders. Register on the event page. Guests may do two CRW rides a year before joining. Helmets required.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:30 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 13–16 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Praline Croissant Women's/NB Ride group ride

The Friday women's and nonbinary ride from Alewife: 20 miles at 13–16 mph through Lexington and Burlington to Mary Cummings Park and Horn Pond, back past Mystic Lakes, with an optional coffee stop at Kickstand Cafe. It regroups and leaves on time so riders get to work; slower riders can ride it at their own pace with navigation.
